dedupe_keys.name: 洪水浸水想定区域 想定最大規模 flood

description: 洪水浸水想定区域(想定最大規模) [flood] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 長崎県. 長崎県知事が指定する想定最大規模の洪水浸水想定区域および家屋倒壊等氾濫想定区域の範囲または位置などのデータをGISデータとして整備したものである。. Coverage: 長崎県. The portal files it under the publisher 長崎県. Its tags are GIS, 家屋倒壊, 氾濫, 河川, 洪水. It offers 1 resource(s) in shp. The portal shows 2025-11-04 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
